caption: Little Caesars employee goes viral after knocking out aggressive customer.
A viral video from a Little Caesars location in Indiana shows an employee knocking out a customer after a heated confrontation behind the counter.

Footage of the incident shows the customer repeatedly getting into the worker’s face before the employee suddenly lands a powerful uppercut, sending the man crashing to the ground. The clip quickly exploded across X, TikTok, and Instagram.

Online reactions have been heavily divided, with some users saying the employee acted in self-defense after the customer crossed behind the counter, while others argued the response was excessive. Reddit reposts and viral fight pages helped spread the video even further in recent days.
The incident has now become one of the most shared viral fast-food fight clips online this week.
